Name: Johanna Müller

Work Experience:
- 2023--Present: Research Associate, Max Planck Institute for Molecular Cell Biology and Genetics. Conducts experimental research on cell signaling pathways in mammalian cells, focusing on protein interactions involved in cellular growth. Designs and implements CRISPR-based gene editing protocols to study gene function. Collaborates with cross-disciplinary teams to integrate bioinformatics analyses with laboratory findings. Supervises undergraduate interns and provides training in advanced microscopy techniques. Presents research outcomes at internal seminars and contributes to grant writing efforts.
- 2022--2022: Intern, Molecular Biology Laboratory, Leibniz Institute for Plant Biochemistry. Assisted in ongoing projects studying plant stress responses at the molecular level. Prepared RNA samples for sequencing and performed quantitative PCR analyse
